subject: sailfish-team/sailfish free-energy pressure-tensor equilibrium, transplanted into src/tensorlbm/phasefield/free_energy_pressure.py (merged, TensorLBM#2136); this round completes the curvature/resolution matrix and adds two equilibrium invariants that were never measured before.

Pooley, Furtado & Carr, Phys. Rev. E 78, 056709 (2008) -- pressure-tensor form of the free-energy binary LBM, mechanical equilibrium dP_NN/dx = 0
Wagner, Int. J. Mod. Phys. B 17, 193 (2003) -- stress/pressure tensor = second moment of the populations
Rowlinson & Widom, J. Chem. Phys. 76, 1140 (1982) -- sigma = integral (P_NN - P_TT) dn, the route used for K1
analytic_anchors_rederived_from_f: sigma = (2/3) sqrt(2 kappa A) = (2/3) A xi
flat interface at equilibrium: P_NN = const, P_TT = P_NN - kappa phi'^2, so integral (P_NN - P_TT) dx = sigma
circular drop: p_in - p_out = sigma / R

kpis.what: max_ab |sum_i f_i^eq c_ia c_ib - (P_ab + rho u_a u_b)| / max|P_ab|
surface tension from the transverse tensor difference, sigma = (1/2) sum_x (P_NN - P_TT) on a periodic two-interface band
max |P_xy| / <P_NN> on a flat interface at rest (isotropy of the transplanted anisotropic coefficients wxy; never measured in round 1)
interface width recovered from the measured normal-tangential stress difference, P_NN - P_TT = kappa sech^4((x-x0)/xi)/xi^2, fitted by 1-D golden-section on the interface cells
p_in - p_out from the measured pressure field vs sigma_analytic / R
max |u| on a static interface / drop

convergence_design.resolution_series: flat_xi2 / flat_xi3 / flat_xi4 -- same physics (A, Gamma, tau), three interface resolutions xi/h = 2, 3, 4; report sigma_tension error, xi_fit error and Pnn_uniformity vs xi/h
convergence_design.curvature_series: dropR16 / dropR24 / dropR32 at fixed xi = 2 -- R/xi = 8, 12, 16; report dp/(sigma/R) vs R/xi
convergence_design.monotonicity_is_diagnostic: the trend of the errors across a series is reported but is NOT part of the pass gate (three points cannot establish a rate; declaring a rate would be an over-claim)

stopping_rule: each drop arm stops when the Laplace jump relative drift between successive 500-step checks is < 1e-3, or at its declared step budget (reported as stop_reason); flat arms always run the full declared budget
declared_exclusions: no GPU / SDAA arm: the sailfish original is CUDA+pyopencl and cannot be built here, so the comparison arm is the semantics transplant in TensorLBM (declared limitation, unchanged from round 1)
single flat interface in a periodic domain is excluded (wrap creates a divergent second interface); the flat arm is a two-interface band and sigma is halved exactly once
Gamma > 0.5 on a static drop with tau_phi = 1.5 is excluded as unstable (round-1 screening, recorded as a parameter boundary, not a transplant error)
